query:
UPDATE mcu_media SET 
  content = '## The MCU''s Forgotten Chapter
The Incredible Hulk holds a unique place in MCU history. Released just 43 days after Iron Man, it proved the MCU wasn''t a one-film experiment — it was a universe. Yet it remains the most overlooked entry in the franchise, partly because Edward Norton was replaced by Mark Ruffalo and Universal (not Disney) still holds distribution rights.

## Why It Matters More Than You Think
General Thunderbolt Ross (William Hurt) became a recurring MCU figure, appearing in Civil War, Infinity War, and Black Widow. The Leader (Tim Blake Nelson) finally returned in Captain America: Brave New World (2025) — a 17-year payoff. The Abomination came back in Shang-Chi and She-Hulk. This film planted seeds that are STILL growing.

## The Norton vs. Ruffalo Debate
Edward Norton brought dramatic intensity to Banner but clashed with Marvel over creative control. He wanted a darker, more character-driven film. Marvel wanted action and connectivity. The result was a compromise that satisfied neither fully, but Norton''s performance remains respected by fans.

## Legacy & Fun Facts
- Only MCU film distributed by Universal Pictures (not Disney/Paramount)
- Norton did uncredited rewrites on the screenplay
- The Harlem battle was one of the MCU''s first major city destruction sequences
- Tony Stark''s post-credits scene was originally planned as a mid-credits scene
- The film references Captain America''s super soldier serum as the basis for Hulk''s creation
- Lou Ferrigno (original TV Hulk) voiced the Hulk and had a cameo as a security guard',
  cardMarketContent = '## Hulk Cards: The Undervalued MCU Collectible
While Iron Man cards get all the attention, Hulk cards represent one of the most undervalued segments in MCU collecting. The **2008 Rittenhouse Incredible Hulk** movie set (72 base cards + inserts) was produced in limited quantities and is increasingly hard to find complete.

### Why Hulk Cards Are Heating Up
- Mark Ruffalo''s portrayal made Hulk a fan favorite across 8+ MCU appearances
- Edward Norton autograph cards are EXTREMELY rare (he rarely signs)
- Hulk appears in nearly every Marvel card set since 2008
- Abomination''s return in Shang-Chi and She-Hulk renewed interest in villain cards
- The 2008 Rittenhouse preview set (H1-H6) was limited to just 999 copies

### Investment Outlook
Norton-signed Hulk cards are the sleeper pick of MCU collecting. With only a handful known to exist, any authenticated Norton auto could become a five-figure card as MCU nostalgia grows.',
  keyCards = '- **2008 Rittenhouse Incredible Hulk Base Set** — 72 cards capturing the film. Complete sets are scarce
- **Preview Set H1-H6** — Limited to 999 sets, these preview cards are highly sought after
- **Edward Norton Autograph Card** — Extremely rare. Norton rarely signs, making authenticated autos potential five-figure cards
- **Incredible Hulk #181 (1974 Comic)** — First appearance of Wolverine. CGC 9.8 copies sell for $30,000+
- **2014 Upper Deck Marvel Premier Hulk Sketch Cards** — Original art cards featuring the Green Goliath
- **Abomination Villain Cards** — Renewed interest after Shang-Chi and She-Hulk appearances'
WHERE slug = 'the-incredible-hulk-2008';
